text:
Sara G: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for INC-2026 — we flagged a recurring pattern (KV cache warm failures under burst load). Need clear owners, timelines, and specific playbook edits. Who can take the triage steps doc, escalation path, and the remediation task list?

Liam C: I can own the triage/playbook edit. Will add a short checklist + commands. Target EOW for a PR.

Miguel R: Thanks. For the playbook, can we include the exact debug commands we used yesterday? Example to grab the pod logs and grep KV errors:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/inference-runtime --since=15m | grep -i "kv_cache"
# if pod is stuck, capture stack and disk usage
kubectl -n inference exec -it $POD -- bash -c 'ps aux | grep inference; df -h'
```
Also include the prefix-KV flush step (`/admin/kv/flush`) and note the risk of cold starts.

Nina (SRE): I'll update the escalation path: if latency > 2s for 3 consecutive minutes, page oncall-1; if that doesn't ack within 5m escalate to oncall-2 and cc infra leads. I'll add the exact Slack escalation play and the paging window to the runbook. Assigning myself to the alert rule change (will open a ticket).

Sara G: @Liam C and @Nina (SRE) — please link PRs/tickets here when created. Also we need a remediation owner for the config change that reduces batch size under heavy tail loads.

Ops Nathan: I'll take the config remediation (adjust default batch_size and add a dynamic target). ETA 2 weeks to test on staging and ship to Dedicated. I'll create a playbook section describing rollback steps.

Liam C: For the triage doc I plan to: 1) Add a short hypothesis checklist, 2) Add the `kubectl` snippets Miguel posted, 3) Add a quick KV warm verification (curl to /metrics for kv_hit_rate). Anyone prefer a different metric?

Miguel R: kv_hit_rate + 95p latency for inference endpoint. Also add a note to check model quantization flags — we saw different behavior with 4-bit builds.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INC-2026 postmortem follow-ups due — please update the incident tracker with owners + due dates by 2026-03-20.

Sara G: Great. To summarize and capture action items here:
- Triagable playbook edits (triage checklist + commands): Liam C — due 2026-03-20.
- Escalation rule + runbook paging: Nina (SRE) — due 2026-03-18, link ticket #INC-2026-ESCL.
- Config remediation (batch_size + dynamic scaling tests): Ops Nathan — due 2026-03-30, will PR docs.
- Add KV warm verification + metrics to smoke tests: Miguel R — will add to staging smoke job before Ops Nathan's tests.

Please drop links to PRs/tickets here when created. If anyone needs help splitting the tasks, say so and we can reassign. :white_check_mark: 

Ops Nathan: I'll post the config PR and the rollback steps once staging run is green.

Liam C: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/runbooks/pulls/84 — includes the commands and the KV check. Please review.

Nina (SRE): Created alert ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2026-ESCL — added escalation windows and Slack play.

Sara G: Thanks all. We'll reconvene next Tues if any blockers. If anything slips, update this thread and the incident tracker.
